newsitem.title: JAPAN: HIS bid-only on news of domestic flights plan.
newsitem.headline: HIS bid-only on news of domestic flights plan.

text.p: Shares in H.I.S. Co Ltd were bid-only in early trade on Monday, buoyed by news that the Tokyo-based discount airline ticket agency plans to start regular domestic flights in a few years' time, traders said.
As of 0031 GMT, the share price was bid-only at 6,180 yen, against its Friday close at 5,980 yen.
Japanese domestic flights are dominated by three major airline companies, and it would be the first time in 43 years that a new company would be set up to offer nationwide flights.
